theorems.name: Submission.cbr_ct_vs_compact_exhaustion
theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)), IsOpen U → ∃ K : ℕ → Set (Euclid P), (∀ i, IsCompact (K i)) ∧ (∀ i, K i ⊆ U) ∧ ∀ C : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact C → C ⊆ U → ∃ i, C ⊆ K i
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
